name: kilo-telegram-notifier
description: Sends Telegram notifications when a Kilo Code task completes, fails, or needs your input.

kiloTelegramNotifier.chatId.description: Telegram chat ID that receives the notifications. Create a bot with @BotFather, start a chat with it, and use a chat ID lookup bot (for example @userinfobot) or the Telegram Bot API getUpdates method to obtain this value.

kiloTelegramNotifier.notifyOnDone.description: Notify when a Kilo task completes successfully.

kiloTelegramNotifier.notifyOnError.description: Notify when a Kilo task terminates with an error.

kiloTelegramNotifier.notifyOnNeedsInput.description: Notify when a Kilo task needs input (a permission decision or an answer).

kiloTelegramNotifier.includeWorkspaceNam.description: Include the workspace name in notification messages.

kiloTelegramNotifier.minimumTransitionIn.description: Minimum milliseconds between two notifications for the same task entering the same state (duplicate suppression window).
